## Activity

During November 2022, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 414 captures. This report summarises activity, image quality and grading outcomes for the month. Capture activity provides the basis for reviewing the service delivered at the clinic and identifying any operational issues requiring follow-up. The clinic should continue to record activity consistently so that changes in workload and performance can be monitored through routine reporting.

## Image quality

There were 18 ungradable images, representing an ungradable rate of 4.3. This result should be reviewed alongside local operating experience and any technical issues reported during capture. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues will support follow-up and help identify whether repeat problems are affecting image quality or increasing the number of ungradable images.

## Grading

A total of 105 results were graded as referable during November 2022. The median grading lag was 2 days. This provides an indication of the time between image capture and completion of grading. The clinic should continue to monitor grading timeliness and referable outcomes as part of routine service oversight, with any persistent concerns raised through the appropriate operational route.
